body.statement: There is a constant \(C_{\alpha}\) depending only on the fixed class constants such that, uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal M\), \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}^{\otimes n}(\mathscr D_n(P)\le\epsilon_n^2)\ge1-\alpha\) for all sufficiently large \(n\).
body.justification: Continuous integrated control is the stochastic replacement for the refuted empirical-frequency grid.
body.gap: Kato, Sasaki, and Ura control finitely many self-normalized complex moments; the present claim controls both marked and unmarked channels continuously over a fixed square.
body.consumer: The result supplies a coverage-valid continuous feasible profile without assuming between-grid transform behavior.
